name: The Lust City
source: You’re a seasoned explorer on a mission with your expedition crew into the deep jungle. Find lost treasure, explore the ancient mysteries that surround the tribe and build your own harem in The Lust City!
translation: 你是經驗老到的探險家，正帶領考察隊深入叢林執行任務。在《The Lust City》中，尋找失落的寶藏，探查圍繞部族的古老謎團，再建立屬於自己的後宮！
